name: Adani Total Gas Ltd.
business_summary: City gas distribution (CNG for vehicles, PNG for homes, commercial and industrial users) across ~35 geographical areas in India, plus a 50% stake in the IOCL-Adani gas JV; promoted by Adani Group (74.8% promoter incl. TotalEnergies' ~37.4%, model knowledge). Revenue Rs 5.9k cr in FY26 (TTM 6.8k cr); EBITDA margin has fallen from 25% to 17% as cheaper administered (APM) gas is replaced by costlier HPHT/NRG/spot gas. Q2 FY27 volume +12% y/y, net profit Rs 173 cr.

exposures.mechanism: LNG/spot +15%. Gas cost ~65% of revenue (Rs ~4.4k cr TTM); ~25% of mix is spot/LNG-linked -> cost +2.4% of revenue-equivalent; CNG/PNG price resets lag so ~50% unrecovered for 1-2 quarters: 0.5 x 1.9% x Rs 6.8k cr = ~Rs 65 cr = -5.4% EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.05 x persistence 0.25 => -1.4; add demand loss on industrial PNG => -1.6.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: volume +12%, revenue +34%, EBITDA margin down on higher gas costs and APM cut (CNBC TV18, Republic, Business Standard)
Spot LNG surge, India gas demand drops

exposures.mechanism: +1 = 10pp cut in APM (administered, ~$6.75/mmbtu) gas allocation to CNG/domestic PNG, replaced by NRG/HPHT/spot gas at ~+$5/mmbtu premium. Gas cost ~Rs 4.4k cr; 10pp = Rs 440 cr at APM price, replacement +75% = +Rs 330 cr; 50% recovered by price => -Rs 165 cr = -13.7% EBITDA x 1.05 x persistence 0.5 => -7.2; haircut (partial prior pass-through) => -5.0. Q2 FY27 already absorbed an APM cut (Republic World, 23 Oct).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: volume +12%, revenue +34%, EBITDA margin down on higher gas costs and APM cut (CNBC TV18, Republic, Business Standard)

exposures.mechanism: Conflicting channels. Positive: CNG's price advantage vs petrol/diesel widens when Brent rises, lifting CNG vehicle conversions and industrial switching (PNG saves vs LPG/fuel oil). Negative: HPHT/new gas and some term LNG are oil-linked (cost +), and Brent spikes raise discount rates for a 100x P/E stock. Pack elasticity -1.44 (t -1.4) leans negative; take -0.8.
INR 3% weaker raises cost of USD-linked gas (about 40% of purchases imported or USD-linked) by ~1.2% of gas cost; unrecovered half for 1-2 quarters => -2% EBITDA x 1.05 x 0.4 => ~-0.8.
Trading at 100x P/E and 12.4x book, equity duration is long; 25bp on the discount rate = ~1.5% on the 20+ year growth cash flows. Debt Rs ~2.5k cr (interest Rs 151 cr TTM) adds <1%.
GDP +1pp: industrial/commercial PNG (~30% of volume) and vehicle activity grow ~1.2pp => volume +0.8% => EBITDA +1.2% (fixed network) x 1.05 x 1.0 structural => +1.0.

CNG is ~55% of volume. +10% auto volumes (CNG fleets, taxis, buses) => CNG volume growth +~4pp => EBITDA +4% (CNG unit margin ~Rs 8-10/kg) x 1.05 x persistence 0.3 => +1.3; haircut for EV substitution in cities => +1.2.

+1 = stronger EV push (electric 3W/buses/cabs in cities where ATGL builds CNG stations): erodes CNG growth in 5-10 years; -3% terminal volume x high multiple (P/E 100) x persistence 1.0 /3 for probability => -1.0.

Hormuz closure raised Asian spot LNG ('most expensive in years', ToI 24 Aug) and cut India's gas demand (OilPrice 14 Oct); ATGL's marginal gas is LNG-linked so margins compress (Q2 EBITDA margin 17% vs 20% a year ago) even with a 'calibrated' CNG hike. Stock -11.6% over 3m. Central -1.5.

evidence.note: Spot LNG surge, India gas demand drops
CNG price hike described as calibrated (Business Today 23 Oct)

exposures.mechanism: FIIs hold 12.8% (stable); beta 1.2 to Nifty and 42% vol imply a flow sensitivity of ~+1.5% per +$5bn quarterly inflow for a high-multiple stock after market beta is removed.

company_links.mechanism: Unit: % change in ATGL equity value per +1% change in Adani Enterprises equity value. Same promoter group; group-wide governance/financing shocks (e.g. the Nov 2024 US indictment episode, model knowledge) moved all Adani stocks together; ATGL's separate TotalEnergies shareholding limits pass-through.
